chunks: When souls are reunited (with the bodies)
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says souls are 'reunited' on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'marriage' of souls to bodies (Zawwajat) signifies the reassembly of the physical form with the spiritual essence, affirming the bodily resurrection (Ba'th al-Jasad) as a literal reality rather than merely spiritual. This event marks the transition from the grave to the final reckoning, where the unity of the human composite is restored to face divine justice.
